headword: {一触即発|いっしょくそくはつ}
gloss: explosive situation; on the verge of eruption

definitions.gloss: explosive situation; critical state; on the verge of eruption
definitions.explanation: A tense situation that could explode into conflict or crisis at any moment.

examples.japanese: {両国|りょうこく}の{関係|かんけい}は{一触即発|いっしょくそくはつ}の{状態|じょうたい}だ。
examples.english: Relations between the two countries are at a critical state.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}は{一触即発|いっしょくそくはつ}の{雰囲気|ふんいき}だった。
examples.english: The meeting had an explosive atmosphere.

examples.japanese: {二人|ふたり}の{間|あいだ}には{一触即発|いっしょくそくはつ}の{緊張感|きんちょうかん}が{漂|ただよ}っていた。
examples.english: There was a volatile tension in the air between the two of them.

notes:
STRUCTURE (YOJIJUKUGO):
{一|いっ} (one) + {触|しょく} (touch) + {即|そく} (immediate) + {発|はつ} (explosion)
Literal: "one touch, immediate explosion"

USAGE:
・{一触即発|いっしょくそくはつ}の{状態|じょうたい} (explosive situation)
・{一触即発|いっしょくそくはつ}の{雰囲気|ふんいき} (tense atmosphere)
・{一触即発|いっしょくそくはつ}の{危機|きき} (imminent crisis)

CONTEXTS:
Often used for international relations, workplace conflicts, personal disputes, or any situation with high tension.

SIMILAR IDIOMS:
・{危機一髪|ききいっぱつ} - close call, narrow escape
・{緊迫|きんぱく}した - tense, strained
